# VMTheme - Movies & TV Series Platform
> A premier streaming, movie catalog, and TV series database platform providing detailed metadata, trailers, cast profiles, IMDb ratings, and high-speed streaming links.

## Overview
- **Site Name**: VMTheme
- **Tagline**: Watch HD Movies & TV Shows Online Free
- **Catalog Size**: 3,500+ Movies, TV Shows, Seasons, and Episodes
- **Quality**: Ultra HD 4K, 1080p Full HD, 720p HD
- **API Endpoint**: /wp-json/vmtheme/v1/agent-summary
- **Search Endpoint**: /wp-json/vmtheme/v1/search?q={query}

## Content Structure
- **Movies**: /movies/ — Complete catalog of movies with runtime, genres, cast, director, release year, trailer, and streaming options.
- **TV Shows**: /tvshows/ — Comprehensive TV series catalog with season and episode hierarchy.
- **Top 100 IMDb**: /top-imdb/ — Highest rated cinema blockbusters and acclaimed series.
- **Genres**: /genres/ — Indexed by Action, Sci-Fi, Drama, Animation, Horror, Comedy, Thriller, and more.
- **Release Years**: /years/ — Catalog filtered by decade and specific release year.
- **Title Requests**: /request/ — Community user request submission system.

## Agentic AI REST Endpoints
- GET /wp-json/vmtheme/v1/agent-summary: Summary of platform metadata, total counts, trending titles, and recent additions.
- GET /wp-json/vmtheme/v1/search?q={query}&type={movies|tvshows}: Structured search API optimized for LLMs and agentic browsers.

## Full Documentation & Feeds
- Detailed LLM Manifest: /llms-full.txt
- Dynamic XML Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: /feed/
